message: The other day, I was trying to explain to my grandkids why we keep extra batteries and snacks in our storm prep kit. They looked at me like I had just suggested we start collecting toenail clippings—completely baffled! But when I mentioned that those snacks might come in handy during a movie marathon if the power goes out, their eyes lit up. Sometimes, it’s all about framing things in a way that makes sense to them. What little tricks do you use to get your kids on board with emergency prep?
